(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder having a defined thermal conductivity; and a solvent.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to a surface of an electronic component whereby enhancing the boiling properties of the component.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is completely removed during application to the electronic component surface.
